summary: Audited 20 test files / 464 tests across release, observability, news, web, incident and forensic suites. 2 tests FAIL at HEAD: (1) release/test_build_script_hardening.py::test_cli_help_strings_are_ascii_safe - cli/main.py now has 2 legit non-ASCII help strings; (2) release/test_release_hardening.py::test_verifier_fails_on_tampered_release - fixture Web assets never hash-match repo-root Web/ source (STALE WEB BUNDLE check). No obsolete/removed-module references found (all nexus_scalp imports resolve; settings/secret_store and release/metadata exist). BUG-054 payload contract is pinned in test_audit_db_growth_bug054.py (outside audited set); BUG-092/093 build-info version truth lives in release_versioning_phase19 + phase17 parse_version tests. 3 near-duplicate pairs across the news_bridge family (identical-timestamp determinism, empty-db export, invalid-impacts JSON) - consolidate to one home, keep causal-boundary determinism. retention-window contract (7d/13d/30d/90d BUG-054/099) is NOT asserted in any audited suite - gap. Diagnostics API suite is thinnest (2 tests/1 file) for a growing read-only surface. No files modified; output written to scratch/audit_release_observability.json.
